## Decision served

Which Osservatorio decision this unit makes more faithful or faster, and how that reduces projected Xylella loss.

## The unit

What changes, in which owner. What this unit does not do.

## Starting point

What is true now and where it is written. What unresolved question or missing input this unit depends on.

## The work

How it is done, in the nouns of the domain: the real-world things, the source population and the accepted consumer that admits it, what one record means, how it is read, what is derived. Name the complete relevant population, never a subset chosen by its answer.

## Done means

What would be observed at the consumer surface when the unit is complete, and what observation would show it wrong. Judgments, not counts or thresholds.

## Where this unit could go wrong

The drifts this kind of work invites (a population chosen by its answer, a reader that only works for known records, a check that can only pass, a catalogue mistaken for a population, history kept as state, process standing in for the result) and what keeps this unit off them.

## What this unlocks

Where the unit sits in the next five and what depends on it.

---

## Changes since plan review

Adjustments made after the plan review, with the reason. "None" if none.

## Result

Filled when the work is complete: what was done, what was learned, what failed or was not attempted, what remains open and where it is now recorded.
